svg.text: a fix would change an approved
Repair loops run before the review_approved gate, so the human sees a clean result or an escalation. Iteration counters are per feature; only “keep repairing” or “redo” resets them.

Source: spec/code-workflow/architecture.md, wire-protocol.md; skills/springboot-feature-bootstrap/references/phase-dispatcher.md. Model tiers apply in Claude Code; Codex runs every phase on the session model.
